name: DCB Bank Limited
remarksWeb: In the format prescribed by Stock Exchanges for disclosure of shareholding pattern, it provides only one heading for disclosing the details of shareholding of Non-Independent Directors under below heading: B4(b) Directors and their relatives (excluding independent directors and nominee directors) Since there is no separate header/ column provided in the format of disclosure as above for providing details of shareholding of Independent Directors, the same is shown under the header- Any Other. Please take note of the above.
